dependencies.reason: Uses its token_workspace_bindings table and idempotent schema function (InitBindingSchema), its bound-slug lookup for a PAT, its token_bound error type and message, and its binding guard on the API group. This spec adds binding-store functions beside its lookup in internal/wsaccess and a refusal-report call at each of its refusal points.

tasks.title: Mint handler: ordered checks and in-process delegation to apikit
steps: Write TS-34-1..TS-34-10 and confirm they fail; use a counting stub http.Handler as Config.APIKit
Register POST /workspaces/:slug/tokens in RegisterRoutes

Implement the checks in order: 401 authentication required; bound PAT -> 403 token_bound with spec 33's message, call wsaccess.ReportBoundRefusal(status 403, surface api), lookup error -> 500 internal server error; admin_token -> 403 admin tokens cannot mint bound tokens; a real user is required as the token's owner; workspace missing / wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace denied / owner_id != auth.UserID -> 404 workspace not found; status != active -> 400 workspace is not active
Do NOT check tokens:manage in hub

Delegation: read the body bytes, build httptest.NewRequest-style POST to strings.TrimSuffix(c.Path(), "/workspaces/:slug/tokens")+"/user/tokens" with the original body, the caller's Authorization header verbatim, Content-Type and Content-Length, and c.Request().Context(); serve with cfg.APIKit into an httptest.ResponseRecorder

Pass the recorded result on to the success/rollback code added in the next task via a small function boundary that already returns a complete response for the non-201 case (copy status, Content-Type and body)

In cmd/af-hub/main.go call boundtoken.RegisterRoutes(server.APIGroup(), boundtoken.Config{DB: database.SqlDB, APIKit: server.Echo(), Audit: auditEmitter}) right after workspace.MountWorkspaceHandlers (read the file with read_file; keep OnAfterUserCreate before Mount for hook_ordering_test.go)

tasks.title: Mint handler: write the binding, answer, and roll back on failure
steps: Write TS-34-11..TS-34-13 and TS-34-15..TS-34-20 and confirm they fail; the property test TS-34-20 uses a failure injector over undecodable body, vanished workspace, insert error and key conflict

In internal/wsaccess add InsertBinding(db, tokenID, slug, createdAt) (written bool, err error) using INSERT INTO token_workspace_bindings SELECT ?, slug, ? FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ? and checking rows affected; and RevokeToken(db, tokenID) error setting revoked_at = apikit.NowUTC() WHERE token_id=? AND revoked_at IS NULL
Non-201 apikit answer: copy status, Content-Type and body byte-for-byte; write no binding, emit nothing
201 with undecodable body or empty token_id/token: revoke when token_id is known, log token_id only, answer 500 failed to bind the token to the workspace
Decodable 201: InsertBinding with apikit.NowUTC(); on success answer 201 with Cache-Control: no-store and body {token_id, token, name, permissions, workspace, expires_at, created_at}
On not written (workspace vanished) revoke and answer 404 workspace not found; on insert error or key conflict revoke and answer 500 failed to bind the token to the workspace
If revocation also fails, log both errors at error level with the token_id and keep the answer
Never log the plaintext token, apikit's 201 body or the Authorization header on any path (TS-34-19 captures the logger)
